verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Missive's shared or private address books sync with Office 365 and Google, which covers contacts from those providers. Nothing shows importing past mail history from an old provider or client, so this is minimal, contacts-only support. Missing for 10: documented import of complete mail history, contact import from other providers or clients (e.g. CSV/vCard), and independent or hands-on corroboration of migration.
